workflow: Manual monthly reconciliation of MRR from multiple payment processors (Stripe, PayPal, manual invoices) into a single spreadsheet for board reporting
current_workaround: Exporting CSVs from each payment system, then using Excel formulas and VLOOKUP to merge and deduplicate records
consequence: Errors in MRR reporting lead to incorrect board presentations, delayed funding decisions, and wasted 8–12 hours per month

workflow: Manual deployment orchestration across multiple cloud environments: copying configs, running scripts, updating load balancer rules, verifying health endpoints
trigger: Every code merge to main branch
current_workaround: A collection of shell scripts and a shared Google Doc with step-by-step runbooks
consequence: Deployment failures happen weekly; rollbacks take 30+ minutes; security gaps due to inconsistent manual steps

target_role: Customer success manager / support team lead
workflow: Manual triage and duplication of support tickets between Zendesk, Slack, and Salesforce: CS agents copy-paste conversations, tag tickets by hand, and update CRM records separately
current_workaround: Agents maintain a personal Slack channel with pinned messages, plus a shared Google Sheet to track high-priority cases
consequence: Missed SLA responses, duplicate effort, loss of context when agents are out sick, and customer churn due to slow resolution
